text: You asked: "say whether D and NEE are one read or two." One read. Same seat, same sector, same shape: an R8 dip-and-reclaim on force (CORRECTION_REENTRY, mp 78.0 STRONG) inside a failed trend leg, ma_50 63.76 under ma_200 64.8 and structure_shift BEARISH_CHOCH. C10 permits only shorts under a falling average; R11 suppresses the long. I counted it once and dropped both. I hold OPPOSE. It clears only if structure_shift stops reading bearish and a rising average is served, then a fresh <=6 to >=7 elder event.
